nonBlockingObservations.title: Show the encoder as fallible and clarify its test population
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Section 0 writes encode(&Control3Root) -> Vec<u8>, while LD-D2A-8 requires refusal of a multi-tuple hello. Spell the API as a Result (or an equally explicit typed refusal), and clarify that encoder acceptance tests cover host-sendable messages, while decoder/schema/matrix tests cover all sixteen types. The context candidate already uses Result<Vec<u8>, EncodeRefusal>, so this is a written-plan clarification rather than a missing refusal decision. Generated public carriers alone are not a guarantee of all wire bounds; implementation review should verify invalid constructed output is refused as required.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Distinguish frame-buffer storage from parser arena storage
nonBlockingObservations.observation: LD-D2A-6's bound-plus-four limit should explicitly refer to the raw stream-frame buffer. LD-D2A-2's arena, container stack, decoded strings and validation work have additional frame-bounded storage, so the one-bounded-allocation wording should not be read as a total allocation ceiling or an exact allocation count. Preserve a clear linear-in-frame storage argument and the nonrecursive Drop/Debug/equality requirement; do not report a 65,540-byte total parser-memory guarantee.
